What we do

We design, build, program, and compete in FIRST Tech Challenge. Our students work across five disciplines: Design, Automation, Reach, Trades, and Strategy.

Each season brings a new challenge and an opportunity to practise engineering, communication, and teamwork.

Ways to help

  • Season support — discuss help with robot components, registration, and team travel.
  • Parts & services — materials, fabrication, tools, or access to equipment.
  • Knowledge & time — technical advice, mentorship, or a workshop.

Let’s find the right fit.

Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll discuss current needs, a useful contribution, and recognition together.
